Introducing Geography Optional DAMP 2027 (Daily Answer Writing & Mentorship Program) at LevelUp IAS, guided by Akhilesh Shrivastava Sir.

🔗 Explore & Enrol Now: https://www.levelupias.com/courses/upsc-geography-optional-daily-answer-writing-damp/

Program Highlights:

✍️ 2 Questions Daily (Monday–Friday) – Regular practice covering Geography Optional Paper I & Paper II.
📝 Evaluation Within 24 Hours – Get timely feedback on your submitted answers.
🎓 Live Answer Discussions – Interactive discussions with Akhilesh Sir every Wednesday and Saturday at 8 PM, along with model answers.
🗺️ Maps, Diagrams & Presentation – Learn to incorporate geographical illustrations, micro-maps and relevant examples into your answers.
📋 2 Full-Length Tests – Assess your Mains readiness with comprehensive tests and evaluation within 7 days.
🤝 Expert Mentorship & Doubt Clearing – Regular guidance from Akhilesh Shrivastava Sir to identify and address your answer-writing gaps.

📅 Batch Details:
Program: Geography Optional DAMP 2027
Batch Starts: 11 November 2026
Mode: Online Only
Faculty: Akhilesh Shrivastava Sir
Target: UPSC CSE Mains 2027

🔗 Enroll Here: https://www.levelupias.com/courses/upsc-geography-optional-daily-answer-writing-damp/

👥 Who Should Join Geography Optional DAMP?
• UPSC 2027 aspirants who have completed Geography Optional but need regular answer-writing practice.
• Students currently preparing Geography Optional who want expert evaluation and guidance.
• UPSC Mains repeaters looking to improve answer structure, content relevance, time management and presentation.

00:00 – Introduction to Geography Optional for UPSC
00:39 – Changing Trends in UPSC Geography Optional
01:28 – Why Answer Writing Is a Game Changer
02:04 – Geography Optional DAMP 2027 Launch
02:27 – Daily Questions, Evaluation & Live Discussions
03:31 – Who Should Join Geography Optional DAMP?
04:19 – How Answer Presentation Impacts Marks
05:11 – Importance of Maps and Micro-Maps
05:59 – Conceptual Diagrams in Geography Answers
06:37 – Understanding the Demand of UPSC Questions
07:08 – How to Write an Effective Introduction
07:52 – Using Current Data and Relevant Examples
08:35 – Mentorship and Final Program Details

About Akhilesh Shrivastava Sir
Akhilesh Sir is an experienced Geography faculty member at LevelUp IAS, teaching General Studies Geography and Geography Optional. His approach focuses on conceptual clarity, maps, geographical reasoning and application-oriented preparation for the UPSC Civil Services Examination.

About LevelUp IAS
LevelUp IAS provides preparation support for UPSC Civil Services Examination through GS Foundation, Optional Subjects, Prelims and Mains programs, test series and mentorship.
Subscribe to LevelUp IAS for UPSC preparation strategies, Geography Optional guidance, UPSC Mains answer writing, current affairs and exam-oriented learning.
